lines.line: Devlog. Her brain is a state machine.
She rests. When the light comes on, she notices, walks over, and kicks it off.
Hold the switch, and her kicks fail. After a few, she might lean on it instead.
Fail enough, and she gives up, sulks, and ignores you.
Keep holding it, and now and then she'll dash at it, just to see.
Turn the light off, and she walks home in the dark. Flip it back and forth, and she loses her temper.
No machine learning. Just states, timers, and a little chance.
